## Reporting Security Issues

Please do not report security issues through public GitHub issues or the forum. Report them privately via **Report a vulnerability** on the Security tab of the repository concerned. If you cannot use GitHub, email [david@grudl.com](mailto:david@grudl.com) and include the word "SECURITY" in the subject line.

I take security bugs very seriously. If you don't hear from me within a week, please ping me. Once I accept the report, a fix should be available and a new version released within days. I will make the bug public once a new version is released or the report is declined.

## Supported Versions

Each minor series of a package is supported for at least two years from its first stable release. The newest series receives all fixes, older supported series receive security fixes only. The supported series of all packages are listed at [nette.org/en/maintenance](https://nette.org/en/maintenance).
